title: 👋 Welcome to the Dashboard Tour
text_expr: "Let's start with a few basics to get you up to speed on the navigation and different elements of the system."

title: Work Modes
text_expr: "The top navigation shows you the current 'work mode' you're in. You can be inside a project, your personal work area, or in the company mode."

title: Left Navigation
text_expr: "The left navigation breaks down the current work mode and gives you access to different areas. Everything presented here is part of the currently selected work mode above."

title: My Profile Bar
text_expr: "Here you'll find links to your account as well as notifications."

title: Your Dashboard Widgets
text_expr: "Your dashboard is broken up into various widgets showing you focused information about your work."

title: Customize Your Dashboard
text_expr: "Widgets can be resized and moved around using the drag and drop functionality."

title: My To-Dos
text_expr: "The My To-Do widget shows you all the tasks that are currently assigned to you."

title: Group To-Dos
text_expr: "You can use the dropdowns here to filter your tasks by project or group them by priority, status, project, or dates."

title: Sort To-Dos
text_expr: "Each To-Do can be dragged and dropped to change its order. You can also drag and drop a task to the calendar to schedule it."

title: Start the Timer
text_expr: "When you're ready to start working on a task, just click the start timer button."

title: Complete a Task
text_expr: "Once a task is complete, you can mark it as done by clicking the status dropdown."

title: Add More Tasks
text_expr: "You can add more tasks by clicking the plus button in each section, or by using the 3-dot menu next to each task."

title: Congratulations!
text_expr: "You've completed the My Work dashboard tour. Head to your project to learn more about project management."

title: Project Menu
text_expr: "The project menu organizes your project into different sections: Data Room - to host all your files and information, Think - to strategize, ideate and define, Make - to manage goals, milestones and tasks."

title: Project Selector
text_expr: "Use the project selector to jump between projects. The left menu shows everything related to your current project."

title: Checklist
text_expr: "The project checklist is a quick reference to see if your project contains all the necessary information for successful execution."

title: Quick Status Updates
text_expr: "You can use status updates to quickly share the progress of your project with your team using red, yellow and green colors. The status will be visible across the application."

title: Progress
text_expr: "The project progress indicator shows you how much work you have completed. It accounts for various task sizes, team velocity, and project milestones."

title: Latest Tasks
text_expr: "The list of latest tasks shows you the most recent tasks added to your project and can be used as a project inbox."

title: Team
text_expr: "The team box shows you the members of this project."

title: Congratulations!
text_expr: "You've completed the project dashboard tour. Head to the To-Dos to learn more about the various ways to manage your tasks."

title: Your Kanban Board
text_expr: "This is your Kanban board. It helps you visualize your work and limit work-in-progress."

title: Work Flow
text_expr: "Tasks move from left to right as they progress. Drag and drop cards to update their status."

title: Flexible Columns
text_expr: "Using the 3-dot menu, you can add or remove columns and rename them."

title: Filter Tasks
text_expr: "You can filter your tasks by various fields like priority, status, project, or dates."

title: Swimlanes
text_expr: "Additionally, you can group your tasks to create Kanban swimlanes. This helps you visualize your work by team members, priority, or milestones."

title: Sprints
text_expr: "If you manage your work in sprints, you can use the dropdown here to select, create, and update sprints."

title: Congratulations!
text_expr: "This concludes the Kanban tour. Head to the Milestones to learn how to create and manage milestones."

title: Milestones
text_expr: "Milestones help you track major outcomes and project phases."

title: Drag & Sort
text_expr: "Each bar represents one milestone. You can drag them along the timeline, reorder, and resize them. Everything you do on this screen updates the timing of your milestones."

title: Filter
text_expr: "You can filter your milestones and also view tasks that are part of them."

title: Timeframes
text_expr: "You can change the timeframe of the timeline view to see more of the year or dive deep into a daily breakdown."

title: Congratulations!
text_expr: "This concludes the milestone tour. Head to the Goals to learn how to create and manage goals."

title: Goals
text_expr: "Goals help you track measurable impact on your projects."

title: Objectives & Metrics
text_expr: "Each goal is made up of an Objective (what you're trying to accomplish) and a Metric (how you'll measure it)."

title: Goal Progress
text_expr: "As you update your goal metrics, the progress bar will show you how far along you are."

title: Milestones & Goals
text_expr: "You can connect goals to milestones to track the task-level progress of your goals. This helps identify gaps in your project plan."

title: Congratulations!
text_expr: "This concludes the goals tour. Milestones, Goals, and To-Dos are the basic building blocks of the system. Use them to break down your work into manageable chunks. Head to the Kanban Board to review your tasks."
